releases.body:
LinBox bionic rootfs 专用 Box64（aarch64 / NDK bionic 链接 / -DANDROID=ON / ARM_DYNAREC）

- bionic ELF（PT_INTERP=/system/bin/linker64），与 rootfs 内
  wine / mesa / pulseaudio 等二进制同链同形态；box64 本体零
  glibc 依赖
- 完整安装集（不再只有单个 box64 执行文件）：
  `usr/local/bin/box64` + `usr/bin/box64` PATH 入口链接
  + `usr/lib/box64-x86_64-linux-gnu/libc++_shared.so`
  （上游 ANDROID 模式配套，被仿真 x86_64 程序的 C++ 标准库）
  + `usr/etc/box64.box64rc`（系统级调优开关）
  + `usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/`（`ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`
  私有加载器与 aarch64 glibc 运行库 —— glibc 形态 box64
  与 rootfs 内 glibc 二进制的运行层）
  + `usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/`（被仿真 x86_64 程序的
  glibc 运行库，box64 经 BOX64_LD_LIBRARY_PATH 查找）
- 手动安装: 解包 `linbox-box64-*.tar.gz` 至 /（data/data/com.linbox/...
  自动就位），或 `linbox-container install-box64 <tar.gz|URL>`
- 安装后 linbox-container 自动探测 /usr/local/bin/box64
- 用途: 在 aarch64 设备上运行 x86_64 Wine（backend=box64）；
  v0.4.4 为 hangover-11.16 官方配套版本（错配可致 wineboot SEH 级联崩溃）
- 注意: 与完整 rootfs 包（build-bionic-rootfs）同源 —— rootfs 已内置

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.2
releases.body:
## What's new

### Android: an in-game menu
- In the game, press **Back three times** quickly (or **Guide** on a controller) to open the pause menu. The game pauses while it is open.
- The menu has:
  - **Resume**
  - **Frame rate**: takes effect after a restart, and the menu says so.
  - **Touch controls**: Off / Default / Always. Changes apply right away and are saved.
  - **Report a bug**
  - **Quit to launcher**: asks you to confirm first.
- Use it with touch or a controller: A selects; B, Back, Start or Guide close it.

### Launchers in your language
- The PC and phone launchers now come in English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese, following the system language.
- On PC, set `B3_LANG=en`, `zh` or `ja` to choose one yourself.

### Phone: add the app to game mode
- Some phones keep CPU clocks low for apps that are not on the system's game list. The launcher now shows a gold card asking you to add the app to the phone's game mode or game center; otherwise the game may not run at full speed.
- Tap **Done, hide this** once you've added it.
- A line under **START** reminds you how to open the in-game menu.

### Not yet tested on a device
- **Tested on a phone:** triple Back.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.1
releases.body:
A fix for a crash after saving.

## Fixes

- **`FATAL: ipc: unimplemented service 'pl:u'` after a save (#12).** On some screens the game asks for the list of system fonts in order of priority. That request went to a system service we don't have, and the game stopped. The fonts it gets are the same ones the game already uses everywhere else, so text is unchanged. Thanks to the reporter in #12 for the log!

## Verified

- The game builds and starts on Windows, and the font request is now answered by the runtime instead of the missing service.
- The screen that makes the request wasn't reached in our own test, so please tell us in #12 if it still happens.

## Coming from v0.4.0

- **Desktop:** unpack over the old folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher. Saves and settings stay.
- **Android:** install the new APK over the old one, then **SET UP** again (or **Send to my phone** from a computer that has the game). Saves and game files stay, in Internal storage or on the SD card, wherever you chose.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.4.0
releases.body:
The Android app can now keep the game on an SD card.

## New

- **Game folder on an SD card (Android, experimental).** Settings has a new **Game folder** row: choose Internal storage or an inserted SD card (or USB drive). Suggested in #12.
  - **Not set up yet:** choose the card first and put your dump on it (`Bayonetta 3/dump`, Download or Documents on the card). **SET UP** then puts the game there. The setup looks on the chosen storage first. A dump on the other storage also works, but it is copied, so it needs as much free space again. The free-space check counts that.
  - **Already set up:** choosing the card offers to **move** the game there: game data, saves, settings and shader cache. Everything is copied first, and the old folder is removed only after every file has arrived. If the move stops halfway, the game stays where it was.
  - **A card that already holds the game** is used as it is.
  - The built game itself stays in the app's private storage, so the SD card only needs to hold data. Use an exFAT card: FAT32 can't hold files of 4 GB or more.
  - **Send to my phone** now copies the game into the folder chosen in the app.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.17
releases.body:
Know before you set up: the app and the launchers now check whether your device can run the game.

## New

- **A minimum spec, checked for you.** Below it, setting up takes 30 to 60 minutes and can end in a black screen, so the app and launchers now say so first. Below the minimum they stop by default and explain why, with a choice to try anyway. If a device only falls short of the recommended spec, you get a warning.
  - **Android:** the app checks when it opens and again before **SET UP** or **START**. Minimum: Vulkan 1.3, a CPU core at 2.4 GHz or faster, 6 GB of memory, and an Adreno 640 / Mali-G68 class GPU or newer. Older Mali GPUs (G31 to G76), Mali-T, PowerVR and Maleoon are below it. Recommended: Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 or newer with 8 GB.
  - **Send to my phone** checks the phone before it builds anything, and asks before sending to a phone below the minimum (`b3_win.py phone --anyway` on the command line).

releases.name: v0.2.7: Multi-region hooks, black models/cubemaps fix & NVN write-back/spill perf
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata Android Recomp v0.2.7

### Español
- **Soporte multi-región y fix de modelos negros (PR #26 / PR #27):** Resolución automática `ADRP+LDR` para USA y Asia 1.0.3 (presenter y resolución dinámica mínima `0.6`) y firma ampliada de 8 instrucciones en `mesh_draw_hook` para evitar falsos matches y modelos/naves en negro.
- **Corrección de reflejos/cubemaps negros:** Añadido `VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT` en texturas `2D_ARRAY` cuadradas de `6n` capas.
- **Optimizaciones de rendimiento NVN:** Salida rápida con `memcmp` + comparación SIMD NEON ARM64 en write-backs (`apply_write_back`), pool de snapshots (`g_before_pool`) y pool de buffers spill (`g_staging_pool`) para reducir pausas de CPU y asignaciones de memoria por frame.
- **Fix Android 10 (API 29) y diagonales en mando:** Guard de `InsetsController` para evitar crashes al iniciar en Android 10 y zona muerta radial 2D para sticks físicos.

---

### English
- **Multi-region hooks & black models fix (PR #26 / PR #27):** Automatic `ADRP+LDR` slot resolution across USA and Asia 1.0.3 builds (presenter & dynamic-res floor `0.6`) plus expanded 8-instruction `mesh_draw_hook` signature to prevent black 3D models/ships.

releases.name: v0.2.5: Fix continuous phantom dodge/evade & SixAxis decouple
releases.body:
## NieR:Automata for Android v0.2.5

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras

- **Continuous Phantom Dodge/Evade Fixed / Corrección de esquiva/dash continuo fantasma (Fixes #13, #15, #18):**
  - **IHidServer IsSixAxisSensorAtRest (cmd 82):** Implemented Horizon OS nn::hid::IHidServer command 82, returning isAtRest = true. Previously, unhandled command 82 returned false, tricking the game into detecting constant controller movement and triggering endless motion-controlled evades/dashes.
  - **SixAxis Angular Velocity Decoupling:** Restricted right-stick gyro motion aiming simulation exclusively to Persona 5 Royal (Darts minigame). In NieR, the right stick controls the camera; feeding stick inputs into the virtual gyro was generating violent angular velocity spikes that triggered unwanted evade maneuvers when looking around.
  - **Versión oficial v0.2.5 (versionCode 7):** Se corrigió la esquiva automática e incontrolable del personaje al implementar el comando IPC IsSixAxisSensorAtRest y desacoplar la simulación giroscópica del stick derecho de la cámara.

- 整合声音、对白、亮度、纹理、植被显示与运行时内存修复，混音器默认启用。
- 修正 Mali 顶点整数属性与着色器输入类型匹配，RG477M 人物已可正常显示。

RG477M / MT6897 / Mali-G615 / Android 14 已验证安装、原版 Ver1.07 标题、声音恢复、人物显示、开场至户外与城镇流程、虚拟手柄和原游戏存档缩略图。图形组件测试 64 项中 63 通过、1 项缺私有输入跳过，运行时 8 项通过。

releases.body:
* Fixed GB, GBC and GBA games running slow on PAL (576i) 50Hz output
* Fixed JIT IRQ latency bug causing graphical artifacts
* **Restored the original controls of the games with special Wii controls** (Zelda, Mario, Metroid, Ninja Turtles, Mortal Kombat, Star Wars, Harry Potter, Medal of Honor, Boktai, The Lord of the Rings, Castlevania and the rest). # v0.0.8.2 Experimental — Stability Update & On-Screen Control Editor

Small stability update on top of `v0.0.7.9-experimental`. Still experimental — please use **EXPORT LOGS** when reporting anything.

## New: customize the on-screen controls

A **CUSTOMIZE** pill now sits next to **TOUCH** in the HUD. It opens an in-place editor:

- Tap a control to select it, then **drag** to move it.
- **S- / S+** resize, **O- / O+** change opacity.
- **BIND** cycles a button's guest input index.
- **PRESET** cycles DEFAULT → COMPACT → LEFT → RIGHT.
- **RESET** restores the original layout, **DONE** saves and exits.

Layouts are stored as normalized coordinates, so they survive rotation/window resizing and app restarts. Guest input is suppressed while the editor is open (no phantom presses), gamepad focus rules are unchanged, and **TOUCH: OFF** also leaves edit mode.

## Stability / rendering correctness (from the in-progress post-0.0.7.9 patch)

- Pixel shaders now use full FP32 with NaN-safe multiply helpers (`mulL`/`mulL1`), clamp-before-scale texture adjustment, and `isnan()` output sanitization — removes FP16 overflow/NaN artifacts without changing the guest shader set.

releases.name: v2.5.17 — Microsoft sign-in
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Microsoft sign-in no longer opens a blank white page** ([#3](https://github.com/FlameLaunchers/FlameLauncher-Android/issues/3)). Android's WebView puts `; wv` in its user agent, Microsoft reads that as an embedded browser and refuses the page — and what you get is not a message, it is an empty white screen. The marker is gone from the user agent now.

  Two more things the sign-in page needs were missing: cross-site cookies, which `login.live.com` relies on, and a `WebChromeClient`, without which the popups and dialogs the flow opens are silently dropped. The iOS build never hit any of this because WKWebView reports itself as Safari and handles those by default.
- **A sign-in page that fails to load now says why.** Main-frame errors were going nowhere, so a failure left the same white screen with nothing to report.

releases.name: v2.5.16 — Minecraft 26.4 snapshots
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 snapshots start.** A version id like `26.4-snapshot-3` splits into `26` and `4-snapshot-3`, and reading that second part as a plain integer gave nothing — so 26.4 was treated as 26.0, missed the SDL and LWJGL 3.4.3 stack, and launched on LWJGL 3.3.6 instead. The game died immediately with `NoClassDefFoundError: org/lwjgl/sdl/SDLPlatform`; the cacio lines in the crash report were a consequence, not the cause. Version numbers are now read digit by digit, so snapshot, pre-release and rc suffixes no longer hide them, and five tests cover the shapes.
- Carries the previous fix as well: on Java 24 and newer the cacio java agent is skipped, because the `sun.misc.Unsafe` calls its `premain` depends on are refused there and a failing agent takes the VM with it.

releases.name: v2.5.15 — Minecraft 26.4 starts again
releases.body:
## What's new

- **Minecraft 26.4 (and anything else on Java 24 or newer) starts again.** The cacio setup loaded a java agent whose `premain` overwrites the AWT toolkit's static fields through `sun.misc.Unsafe` (`staticFieldBase`, `staticFieldOffset`, `putObject`). Those methods are refused from JDK 24 and gone in 26, and a failing agent takes the whole VM down with it — which surfaced as a cacio error at startup.

  The iOS build has always run the same cacio jars without that agent, on the same Java 25, using only `-Dawt.toolkit` and `-Xbootclasspath/a`. Android now does the same on Java 24+ and keeps the agent only for the older runtimes that still need it.

## Lemon-Project v1.6.0

A round of fixes from your logs and reports, plus three things you asked for: a Nintendo button layout for physical controllers, frontends that bring a game's update and DLC along, and the Immediate GPU fences back as an option for advanced users.

### New
- **Button layout** (Settings → Controls): **Nintendo** swaps A↔B and X↔Y of your physical controller in games, so each button presses what a Switch has in its place. For handhelds and controllers with Xbox-style labels. Menus, hotkeys and button mapping still see the buttons as labelled.

When on, the game hears that the GPU is done as soon as the work is queued, instead of waiting for it to finish. releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.2 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Restores compatibility with third-party native mods. If mods failed to load, or loaded and then force-closed the game, this is the fix.

### Fixed

* **Mods failed to load with "Unknown mod load failure".** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  Adding the companion's slot I/II buttons pushed `BTN_R` to `1 << 8` and widened `daAlink_c::itemTriggerCheck` / `itemButtonCheck` from `u8` to `u16`. That changes the mangled names, so mods built against upstream Dusklight could not resolve them and failed at `dlopen`. The upstream symbols are re-exported as forwarders that translate the button numbering as well as the width — upstream's `BTN_B` is `BTN_S2` here, so widening alone would have routed a sword check to a slot button.

  Measured against three mods: only 2 of 842, 762 and 55 game-symbol imports were unresolved.

* **The game force-closed when a loaded mod ran.**

releases.name: Dual-Screen 3.0.1 (based on Dusklight v2.0.0)
releases.body:
Patch release for **Dual-Screen 3.0**. No gameplay or dual-screen changes — the native code is identical to 3.0.

### Fixed

* **Cosmetics, Luau Support and Randomizer were missing from the Android build.** ([#6](https://github.com/igawa6/dusklight/issues/6))

  The Android CMake presets listed only the `dusklight` target, so the `dusklight_mods` aggregate target never ran and `bundled_mods/` was never produced. Gradle packs that directory into `assets/mods`, so the APK shipped with no bundled mod packages at all. Mods that depend on the Luau runtime could not load either.

  All three packages are now present: `cosmetics`, `luau_runtime` and `randomizer`.

  CI was never affected — `build.yml` builds `dusklight_mods` as its own explicit `--target` step. This only broke preset-driven local builds.

The charge punch on the walls of a building, with the Charge Punch upgrade.

RampageRE v1.2.4

Buildings falling by themselves, grabbing and eating, and a few smaller things from the same report.

- Buildings no longer collapse out of nowhere at the start of a city's boss block. In a city played for more than

releases.name: 1.0.0 Risshun
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。

releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

**Console Five Pro v0.0.9proQ4** — an independent rebranded build of CapyPS5 v0.0.3, the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android (built on KytyPS5 and the FEX x86-64 JIT).

## v0.0.9proQ4 — the freeze fix, the after-freeze crash, frame flow in heavy 3D (same graphics)
- **Fixed: the multi-second freezes.** A draw whose pipeline was still compiling used to block the renderer with an *unbounded* wait on the compile queue. A storm of first-visit pipelines (a new area, material streaming, one-shot LUT passes) could then park the whole renderer behind the workers for tens of seconds - the field logs show 14-28 s of frozen video and starved audio right before the session died. No draw waits more than `debug.capy.pipeline_wait_ms` (default 4 ms, 0 = never wait) now: past the bound the draw is skipped, the compile lands in the background, and the next occurrence draws for real. Every pipeline miss is queued to the async workers - the renderer never compiles inline during play.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3.1-dev
releases.body:
The Sims 2 for Android **0.3.1-dev** improves Lua error handling, material creation, renderer diagnostics, texture conversion, and the launcher. Changes since **0.3-dev**, from signed source commit `a84f6585caca7a90afe140540714f879800c33bb`.

One APK includes **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The minimum requirements are now **Android 8.0 (API 26)** and **OpenGL ES 3.1**; the native Vulkan renderer accepts **Vulkan 1.0**. Game data must come from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. Android 8.0–8.1 and GLES 3.1-only devices still need further device testing.

## Stability and startup

- Fixed the embedded MSVC `setjmp/longjmp` implementation used by Lua: returning to an error handler now unwinds the actual native call stack as well as restoring guest state. The bridge covers all 34 original setjmp call sites and both longjmp epilogues.
- Handle nested and repeated Lua errors, restore exception state, and remove jump contexts when their function returns, a C++ handler unwinds past them, or their thread ends. A jump to a function that has already returned is diagnosed.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.3-dev
releases.body:
One APK now supports both **arm64-v8a** and experimental **armeabi-v7a**. The port requires Android 10 or later, OpenGL ES 3.2, and game data from a compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection installation. ARM32 also requires Thumb-2, NEON, and 4 KiB kernel pages. Android chooses the ABI, and the app unpacks the matching XZ-compressed engine on first use.

## Graphics and performance

- Fixed flickering and missing objects on Mali-G51 in OpenGL ES. The workaround defaults to on and can be changed in Advanced renderer settings. Fixed a related driver hang reproduced on Mali-T830.
- OpenGL ES compiles and links uncached shader programs in the background, reducing stalls when zooming out, rotating the camera, or changing floors.
- The in-game **Minimal Graphics** preset lowers 11 settings to reduce memory use. It saves the previous values, persists across restarts, and restores those values when switched off.
- **Android performance hints (ADPF) are off by default.** The launcher still lets you turn them on for the next game start.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
## What's new since 0.2-dev

- **Vulkan textures.** DXT1, DXT3, and DXT5 now use the correct BC formats on drivers that support them. This fixes colored noise on terrain, roads, and trees seen on Adreno 735 with both the system Vulkan driver and Turnip.
- **OpenGL ES.** Fixed dynamic buffer updates that could corrupt neighborhood chooser panels and text on Adreno 650 and 735, and the neighborhood HUD on Adreno 650.
- **Vulkan UI scaling.** The APK now includes precompiled SPIR-V variants for FSR 1 UI scaling for all 81 pixel shader entries and the built-in fixed-function pixel shader. Shaders outside the library, including shaders used by some mods, can still be compiled on the device.
- **Shader coverage.** The bundled library grew from 194 to 380 captured shaders and from 215 to 408 entries, including sampler variants. The updated capture tool checks bytecode hashes and records sampler variants. A strict diagnostic mode and a library format check help verify coverage.

## Install or update

Download the APK below or check for updates in the launcher. This build supports ARM64 devices running Android 10 or later and requires compatible The Sims 2 Legacy Collection game files.

releases.name: The Sims 2 for Android 0.2-dev
releases.body:

- **Graphics.** The port's own OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan 1.1 renderers handle Direct3D 9 calls. OpenGL ES is the default. Vulkan supports the system driver, bundled Turnip or PanVK on compatible devices, and imported drivers. DXVK has been removed.

> ⚠️ The game is not included — you need your own legally obtained, **decrypted** PS5 dump (PPSA29802).

- **A second player (2P) joined when pausing.** The game opens a second ("special") pad port, and it got the same input as the real pad, so Options there counted as player 2 joining. Only the standard port is the pad now.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.2

Source revision: `48f360d1edca3859f72e447e6943a21ee8eede91` (version code 5, version name `0.2.2-stable+48f360d`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Same game presets on every phone**
- Game presets are no longer limited to particular processors, and the Snapdragon-specific BeamNG Box64 presets are gone. Every phone sees the same presets.
- Presets no longer name a GPU driver; the app picks one for your GPU:
  - Linux games get a Turnip driver when a preset is imported, when a shortcut is created and when a game starts. Adreno 735, 740 and 750 get Mesa Turnip 26.2.2; Adreno 730 gets Turnip v27.0.0 r6; Adreno 8xx keeps its current driver.

**Crashes**
- Games no longer crash with SIGSYS on Android versions whose system-call filter refuses calls FEX makes (all FEX + bionic BeamNG starts on a POCO F6 with Android 14 died this way). A refused call now fails normally and is logged to `Winlator/logs/sigsys.log`.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.1

Source revision: `e750c469bed4a87644a1dac43ff7e1a137d32120` (version code 4, version name `0.2.1-stable+e750c46`).

### Fixes and improvements

**Counter-Strike 2**
- CS2 starts again on a fresh install. The game stopped with "A game file appears to be missing or corrupted" because its Panorama text library could not load next to the root filesystem's newer HarfBuzz. The app now carries the six small font libraries it needs (unmodified Debian 11 builds of HarfBuzz, FriBidi, libthai, libdatrie, Graphite2 and Pixman) instead of relying on Valve's Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper) being installed.
- The menu's background videos play from a Steam library on shared storage. The x86-64 and 32-bit x86 shims were missing the `flock` fallback that the aarch64 one already had, so file locks failed on shared storage.

**BeamNG.drive**
- BeamNG 0.39 and 0.40 now offer a single preset: FEX + bionic, no PRoot, direct launch, 960x544. The Box64, Box64 bionic, SoC-specific Box64 and Windows ARM64 presets are removed from those two versions; older BeamNG versions keep theirs.

## SkyNetEmu 0.2.0

Source revision: `5e2bcd1806815831a04d18b2b843735200461d0f` (version code 3, version name `0.2.0-stable+5e2bcd1`).

**Linux games on Android**
- Linux games can run on the bionic FEX without PRoot (direct FEX bridge), with game profiles and presets for BeamNG.drive 0.34, 0.39 and 0.40, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider, Dead Island Definitive Edition, Alien: Isolation and Counter-Strike 2. releases.body:
# 宝可梦传说 Z‑A 安卓移植 · Mali 零拷贝修复版（宿主 APK）

**这是一个“宿主”APK：只含移植运行时，不含任何游戏数据、NSO、资源或密钥。**
运行它需要你**自备自己游戏卡带/数字版的转储**，并用 [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android)
的 porter 生成数据包（步骤见仓库 README 的「怎么用」与「自备文件与公开性」）。

## 这版修了什么（Mali‑G925 上 3 FPS → 30 FPS）

- **根因**：MTK（MT6991）的 gralloc 给 `AHardwareBuffer` 的 native handle 有 3 个 fd，
  `fd[0]` 是 size 0 的只读元数据文件，`fd[1]` 才是 dma-buf（`st_size == 缓冲区大小`）。
  上游恒取 `fds[0]` 去 `mmap`，于是这台 Mali 上 771 MB 的 NVN 内存池**全部**退回
  “每提交整池双向 memcpy”，每帧约 375 ms——这正是帧时间的大头。
- **修法**：`ahb_buf_fd()` 按 `fstat().st_size == 池大小` 选出真正的 dma-buf fd；
  `pool_zero_copy()` 与 `vk_pool_remap_ro()` 都改用它。补丁全文：
  [`patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch`](https://github.com/Timqt/pokelegza-and/blob/main/patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch)
- **实测**（25079RPDCC，Dimensity 9400 级，Mali‑G925‑Immortalis MC12，Vulkan 1.3.278）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 零拷贝内存池 | 0 / 771 MB | **771.2 / 771.2 MB** |
| 菜单 FPS | 2–3 | **30**（游戏自身 present interval 上限） |
| 帧工作 p50 | 343 ms | **16.9 ms** |
| submit+present | 53–82 ms | 3–4.5 ms |

- 已能从语言选择一路进到开场列车场景（字幕 “Your train has arrived in Lumiose
  City!”）。当前瓶颈是 GPU 渲染（场景内约 20–25 ms，≈48 FPS 上限）。

## 使用

uncharted-android 0.3.7 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: dumps made with Itemzflow now prepare and play. The app takes executables that are already decrypted (plain ELF files), and Itemzflow's update folder. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **A dump made with Itemzflow stopped at Preparing with `eboot.bin: expected PS4 SELF` (#40).** Itemzflow writes the executables already decrypted, as plain ELF files without the SELF wrapper. The app now takes those as well (eboot.bin, the two .elf files, libc.prx and libSceFios2.prx), as uncharted_pc does since its #498. - **Itemzflow's update folder is found.** `<game folder>-patch` next to the game folder (for example `CUSA02320-patch` next to `CUSA02320`) now counts as the update folder, like `<game folder>-UPDATE`. Choose the game folder and press Prepare: the launcher names the update folder it uses.

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.6 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.6 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.15) - **beta**: upstream uncharted_pc 0.3.15 is merged (Uncharted 3's Load Game hang and fixes for checkpoint loads and textures), a rare crash of Uncharted 1 is fixed, Uncharted 3 gains about 1 FPS without the frame rate limit, and the GPU skinning checks its own inputs, so the rare GPU fault storms can no longer start there. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 1 could close now and then in play.** On the Retroid Pocket G2 this happened about once in three hours without the frame rate limit. A job of the game's scene update read an object whose two fields the game's other code had not filled yet. The update now waits up to about 1.6 ms for them, and if they are still empty it skips the one query that needs them; the game does not use that query's result. In a test that skipped the query every time for two minutes, the game played on unharmed.

releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.5 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's spider rooms run at full speed (chapter 7 ran at 10-15 FPS on the Retroid Pocket G2), a rare hang or crash of Uncharted 3 is fixed, and the app now says what is wrong with a copy of the game instead of crashing or stalling without a word. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: the rooms with the spider swarm ran at 10-15 FPS** - chapter 7, "Stay in the Light", and the swarm's return in chapter 11; on the Retroid Pocket G2 at 1280x720 the room now holds the 30 FPS limit (15.0 and 13.2 FPS before, 30.0 and 30.0 after, in two pairs of runs). One pixel shader of the swarm's material picks values from a small table by an index. The translated shader chose among all 84 of its registers at each of twelve such reads, more than the shader compiler of an Adreno has registers for, so it kept values in memory: 52 ms of GPU time a frame for a small part of the screen. The reads are now limited to the table (0.5 ms a frame); the picture is the same

releases.name: uncharted-android 0.3.4 (beta)
releases.body:
uncharted-android 0.3.4 (base: uncharted_pc 0.3.14) - **beta**: Uncharted 3's desert chapters are drawn right - Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were stretched across the screen, on every device. **No game files are included**: you need your own decrypted dump of the collection (version 1.02 of the executables). Please attach the log to a report (Saves and logs > Copy the log).

**Fixed**
- **Uncharted 3: Drake's desert clothes from chapter 16 on and the horses of chapters 19 and 20 were drawn as stretched triangles** (#35). It reads the layout of every job now and batches both; a layout it does not know goes the ordinary way and is named in the log. # 🛡️ [MOD] Exiled Kingdoms LAN Multiplayer — 2.0!

Hey everyone! Another update to the **LAN Multiplayer** mod for Exiled Kingdoms.

---

### 🐛 Bug: Crash when entering Cities
- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.
- **Fix:** Problem fixed, and you can now teleport and enter cities perfectly.

### 🐛 Bug: Monsters ignored the CLIENT when the HOST was far away
- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

**You need your own copy of WWE 2K14 for the Xbox 360.** This download contains no game files: the launcher asks for
the files you copied from your own disc, or a disc image of it.

2. Start **`wwe2k14_launcher.exe`**. Windows SmartScreen may warn because the program isn't signed: click **More

   pick any match of that mode.

zip.

**What you need:** Windows 10 version 1803 or newer, or Windows 11 (64-bit), a graphics card with Vulkan support, and your WWE 2K14 Xbox 360 disc
(version 0.0.0.2, no title update), copied to your PC. A controller is recommended.

- 修正目录大小写导致的标题及已下载状态识别失败。
- 登录错误读取 Steam 返回的结果码，改善认证拒绝与请求频繁的提示。

## 版本与验证

- 应用版本：`1.4.4`，版本代码：`1004004`。
- 下载修复已通过 HAP 编译及 Steam 回归检查；平板实测 RPG Maker XP 完成下载并正确识别 `RPGXP.exe`。

releases.body:
## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.
